import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static int calculateMaxSubsequence(List<Integer> sequence, int startIdx, int maxDiff) {
        int length = 1;
        for (int idx = startIdx + 1; idx < sequence.size(); ++idx) {
            if (sequence.get(idx) - sequence.get(startIdx) > maxDiff)
                break;
            ++length;
        }
        return length;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int totalElements = scanner.nextInt();
        List<Integer> sequence = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < totalElements; i++) {
            int val = scanner.nextInt();
            sequence.add(val);
        }
        int maxTimeAllowed = scanner.nextInt();
        Collections.sort(sequence);
        int maxSubseq = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < sequence.size(); i++) {
            int length = calculateMaxSubsequence(sequence, i, maxTimeAllowed);
            if (length > maxSubseq)
                maxSubseq = length;
        }
        System.out.println(maxSubseq);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
